blocks.title: Privacy policy
blocks.subline: The sections below are an outline. Replace each with your details and have the text reviewed by an expert; empty a section that does not apply (title and paragraphs) — it is then not shown.

blocks.title: Controller
paras: Replace with your details: who is responsible for processing personal data — company name, address, email address for privacy requests.

blocks.title: Data collected when visiting the website
paras: Replace with your details: which data arise when the website is accessed (for example server logs), what for and how long they are kept.

blocks.title: Cookies
paras: Replace with your details: which cookies the website sets and what for.

blocks.title: Contact form and email
paras: Replace with your details: which details the contact form and emails collect, what they are used for and how long they are kept.

blocks.title: Third-party services
paras: Replace with your details: which third-party services are embedded (for example statistics, maps, fonts) — or empty the section.

blocks.title: Disclosure abroad
paras: Replace with your details: whether personal data are disclosed abroad, to which countries and with which safeguards.

blocks.title: Retention period
paras: Replace with your details: how long which data are kept.

blocks.title: Your rights
paras: Replace with your details: which rights data subjects have (for example access, correction, erasure) and where to send a request.

blocks.title: Changes
paras: Replace with your details: that this policy may be updated, and the date of the current version.
